title: fix(spec,app-shell): zh-CN view panel reads Chinese on every row of its collapsed sections
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB5hMAwYpcBhDQ6HsKVez9s8)_

Fixes #30267

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：中文控制台下，Studio 视图属性面板里「表格选项 / 分页 / 终端用户控制 / 导航与共享」四个折叠区块展开后的行名与说明全部变成中文（实测英文行 70 → 9，剩下 9 个是「允许的可视化」里的类型选项名 Grid / Kanban 等）；英文控制台文字不变。
- 为什么改：这些区块的子项在 spec 表单里没有逐项声明，翻译提取器只认已声明的子项，所以它们从来没有翻译键，任何语言都显示英文；#30039 浏览器验收时发现。
- 风险与回滚：只改表单布局、提示文字与翻译目录，不动数据与接口；面板不再显示两个早已退役的键（导航 `view`、共享 `type`），已存的值保存时原样保留。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/ui/view.form.ts`（逐项声明子字段与提示）、`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.metadata-forms.generated.ts`（中文译文）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-zh-cn.ts`（控制台中文副本）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-i18n.test.ts`，预期全部通过，其中 objectstack#30267 一组断言四个区块下每一行的名称与说明都含中文、英文对照组不含中文。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`viewForm` declared `selection`, `pagination`, `userFilters`, `appearance`, `userActions`, `navigation` and `sharing` as `type: 'composite'` with no children. The panel (`SchemaForm`) then derives the child rows from the JSON Schema, and `os i18n extract` walks only DECLARED children, so none of those rows had a `metadataForms.view.fields['PARENT.CHILD']` key. A zh-CN Studio read 70 English rows across the four collapsed sections.

- **`packages/spec/src/ui/view.form.ts`** spells out every live child of the seven composites (plus hints on `addRecord`'s two existing children), and gives the rows that had no hint one. Every declared hint is byte-equal to the schema `.describe()` text the panel already showed, so an English console reads the same text. `userFilters.fields` is enumerated as a `repeater` with `widget: 'grid'` and `required: true` on `field`, which keeps the inline table it rendered as before (the auto-detected master-detail table), now with translatable column heads.
- **`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`**: `UserFilterFieldSchema`'s six properties carry `.meta({ title })` (Field / Label / Type / Options / Show Count / Default Values, the strings the panel already printed). The repeater-title guard requires it for any enumerated repeater.
- **Retired keys no longer offered**: the schema-derived list rendered the `navigation.view` and `sharing.type` tombstones as editable rows; the declared lists omit them, as `addRecord` already did for its two tombstones. A stored value is not dropped by a panel save: `CompositeField` writes `{ ...obj, [child]: v }` (`SchemaForm.tsx`, the composite `onChange`), so a key the form does not render is carried through unchanged, exactly as before.
- **Catalogs** (`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/*.metadata-forms.generated.ts`): regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`; every new leaf is translated in zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES (the catalog-wide echo ledgers hold all three translated locales at zero en echoes). The provenance companions lose the rows of leaves that are now translated, as the regenerator writes them.
- **Console overlay** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-zh-cn.ts`): copies the platform's zh-CN leaves for every new row, leaf for leaf.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/ui/view-form-composite-children.test.ts` (new): each composite's declared children EQUAL the schema's live keys (tombstones excluded), so a key added to a block later cannot silently drop out of the panel; each declared hint equals its schema description; the repeater's row labels equal the item titles; no retired key is offered.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/view-composite-children.test.ts` (new): population derived from the form; every declared child is a key in all four catalogs, the en leaf is the form's text, zh-CN never echoes en.
- `ui/.../metadata-form-i18n.test.ts`: new objectstack#30267 group, every row label and hint under the four sections contains CJK in zh-CN, a sample per composite, the two retired rows gone, and an en control that reads the spec English with no CJK.
- `object-lifecycle-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts`: positive-control count 701 → 731 (thirty new row labels, authored in all three locales).
- `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`: three `omit` rows for `view` / `userFilters` (`tabs`, `showAllRecords`, `allowAddTab`). The walk resolves the block through the view union to the page-shaped `UserFiltersSchema`; the list arm the form lays out is `ObjectUserFiltersSchema`, which refuses those keys.

Ablation (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation proven on disk, restored to HEAD):

| Mutation | Pin that went red |
|:--|:--|
| delete the overlay row `'userActions.editInline'` | ui: "every row label and every hint under the four sections is Chinese", "a sample of each composite's children" (2 failed / 22) |
| delete the `refresh` declaration from `userActions` | spec: "userActions: declares exactly the schema's live keys" (1 failed / 20) |
| zh-CN `pagination.pageSize` label back to `Page Size` | platform-objects: "zh-CN carries its own text for every leaf" (1 failed / 7) |

## Acceptance notes

- **Live, example CRM, zh-CN**, `/studio/com.example.crm/interfaces?surface=view:crm_lead.all`, four sections expanded, English lines counted per section: 表格选项 5 → 0, 分页 5 → 0, 终端用户控制 44 → 9, 导航与共享 16 → 0 (70 → 9). The 9 left are the `appearance.allowedVisualizations` option chips (Grid, Kanban, Gallery, Calendar, Timeline, Gantt, Map, Chart, Tree): enum values the widget prints raw. The metadata-forms catalog has no channel for a form field's option labels (the extractor emits `label` / `helpText` / `placeholder`), so they are reported, not fixed here. en-US after: the same English rows as before, minus the two tombstone rows; the `userFilters.fields` table still shows `Field*  Label  Type  Options  Show Count  Default Values`.
- File surface beyond the claim's list: `view.zod.ts` (six titles), the two ledger tests above, and the ja-JP / es-ES catalogs (required by the echo ledgers).
- Out of scope, unchanged: the authored-label vs translated-rail mismatch noted in #30265.
